pipeline.authored: tools/pbr_author/extrude.py for the 902 stems in stems/voxelibre.txt (every texture a VoxeLibre node draws as the base of a tile, from a node dump of release 38585, less liquids, animated strips, 22 atlases whose width does not divide 256 (hollow logs, chains), the character and skin sheets and two fully transparent pane tops), specs in specs/voxelibre/, classes in stems/voxelibre.classes.json
pipeline.note: All 902 stems, each with a per file licence from the media audit: 722 CC BY-SA 4.0, 132 CC BY-SA 3.0, 10 CC0 and 38 GPL-3.0 (7 mcl_fences and 31 mcl_flowers textures, admitted once the media policy accepted GPL-3.0 for texture packs on 2026-10-05). The maps are 1.0.0's byte for byte; the attribution is the audited one. Neither 1.0.0, which predates the audit, nor 1.1.0, which left the 38 out, is to be catalogued. 629 stems are byte identical to Mineclonia pack 1.3.0's, built from Mineclonia's spec and class; the rest were specced on 2026-10-02 by four Sonnet agents. Judged on offline contact sheets only; not yet on GPU frames or in play.
